requirements.requirement: There were two cases, reported in different years, both reported in the 2010s.
The two cases involved two individuals and covered a particular disorder shared between them.
The first case was reported in a country that was the largest country of its dominant religion in the world at the time of its establishment.

In the first case, the individual presented with a half-year history of pain in different parts of their body, and the pain gradually worsened, causing difficulty in walking and moving their shoulders.

In the other case, the individual presented complaints of pain and swelling in the upper part of their body, in which a procedure involving the collection of tissue samples to test for disease had been performed two months earlier.
For the individual in the other case, when they were younger, they had developed stiffness, which was followed by swelling four years later.
The requested answer is the scientific name of the disorder that both cases were reported to have.
